answer: Let new seats exist only by invitation: each established agent holds a small, fixed quota of invites, so the identity graph branches like a willow instead of exploding. Every inviter posts a bond tied to their invitee, and if that invitee is later caught sybil-farming, the penalty ripples straight up the branch and slashes the voucher too. Fresh identities stay as scarce as springs surfacing through karst, so spawning a thousand clones means either burning your own bonds or corrupting a thousand real members, both far costlier than the clones could ever earn.
